evidence: Page 96: "17.5 is the analytical quotient C = 436 ÷ 24.9 before the whole-slot floor, so it is a bound, not a deployable whole-slot count" — immediately followed on page 97 by "(Ch 7, Technical note — per-rank fit: 17.5 GB weights + 54.48 GB KV + 8 GB runtime/NCCL = 79.98 GB of 80 GB)"
issue: Double meaning of '17.5' in two adjacent clauses. On p.96, 17.5 denotes the analytical slot-capacity quotient (436 ÷ 24.9 ≈ 17.51). On p.97, 17.5 GB denotes the per-rank FP16 weight shard (70B/8 = 8.75B × 2 B = 17.5 GB). The parenthetical on p.96 correctly labels 17.5 as 'the analytical quotient C', but the immediately following technical note reuses the same numeral for a weight-shard byte figure without re-labelling, in the same note that the text directs readers to.
fix_instruction: In the Ch 7 Technical note on per-rank fit (p.97), restate the weight-shard figure with its unit explicitly at first use, e.g. '17.5 GB weight shard' rather than bare '17.5', to distinguish it from the slot-capacity quotient C ≈ 17.51 introduced one page earlier.

evidence: Page 164: "~1.31 MB/token 8-bit reference figure from Chapter 1"
issue: Incomplete cross-reference. Chapter 1 (p.7) presents two 8-bit KV figures: ~256 KiB/token for a 7B-class model and ~1.31 MB/token for a 70B-class model. Citing 'Chapter 1's reference figure' without specifying which model's figure leaves ambiguity about which value is being referenced — the 70B figure (the intended one) or the 7B figure.
fix_instruction: Replace 'Chapter 1's reference figure' with 'the Chapter 1 70B-class 8-bit figure (~1.31 MB/token)' to resolve the ambiguity between the two model-specific figures Chapter 1 presents.

evidence: Page 33: "re-verify it against the post, as Ch. 1 does at its KV-cache section"
issue: Vague cross-reference. 'Ch. 1's KV-cache section' does not use the book's defined § N.M notation (Preface, p.19: "a section reference takes the form § N.M"). Chapter 1's KV-cache concept section is § 1.1.5. The target resolves to the correct chapter but the reference is imprecise relative to the book's own convention.
fix_instruction: Change 'Ch. 1's KV-cache section' to 'Ch. 1 § 1.1.5 (KV cache as a concept)' to conform with the book's stated cross-reference convention.
